description: This file defines a Polyline class for rendering and managing polylines on a Leaflet map, including styling, updating, and decorator patterns.

classes.name: Polyline
classes.description: A class for creating, updating, and removing polylines with optional decorators on a Leaflet map.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a Polyline instance, creates the polyline and optional decorator on the map.

methods.name: getDecoratorSettings
methods.description: Generates decorator pattern settings for the polyline decorator.

methods.name: updatePolyline
methods.description: Updates the polyline's positions, style, and decorator paths.

methods.name: getPolyStyle
methods.description: Computes style options for the polyline based on settings and data.

methods.name: removePolyline
methods.description: Removes the polyline layer from the map.

methods.name: getPolylineLatLngs
methods.description: Returns the array of latitude/longitude points of the polyline.
